mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' published Quotient Transform crossing its bias-specific zero threshold on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies early onset of a directional move; follow the new direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when the K=+0.85 quotient strictly crosses above zero; short when the K=-0.85 quotient strictly crosses below zero, matching the article's inverted downward-bias rule
mechanism.why_distinct: A 100-period high-pass and period-30 SuperSmoother form a Roofing Filter, a fast-attack .991-decay peak normalizes it, and sign-specific nonlinear quotient transforms move the onset thresholds to X=-.85 for long and X=+.85 for short. It is not a raw Roofing zero-cross, price or moving-average crossover, fixed symmetric oscillator threshold on an untransformed field, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the transform is designed for early trend detection and only triggers while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: nonlinear bias-specific normalized-Roofing onset crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.high_pass: published two-pole high-pass removing periods longer than 100 completed decisions
features.super_smoother: published period-30 two-pole SuperSmoother of the high-pass field
features.event: strict finite Q_long zero cross upward for long or Q_short zero cross downward for short relative to the immediately prior valid decision
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: invalid completed four-hour bars reset HP, smoother, and Peak; initialize recursive outputs and Peak to zero; require 100 uninterrupted observations and finite current/prior quotients

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers positive-K upward-bias and negative-K inverted downward-bias Quotient Transform entries under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, decay, K, recursion, normalization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, The Quotient Transform, TASC August 2014
external_basis.fixed_definition: maxBarsLen=100, LPPeriod=30, peak decay=.991, K=+.85 for upward bias; HP and SuperSmoother Roofing Filter; X=Filt/Peak; Quotient=(X+K)/(K*X+1); long when positive-K quotient crosses above zero; article also specifies negative K and inverted logic for short entry in a downward-biased market
external_basis.selection_use: published parameters, recursions, normalization, positive/negative K transforms, and their stated entry directions only; no incidence or outcomes
